items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: He played in my band. Joe Phillips.

ctx.x: Telephone. No, it's not Jack Willis.

I'll tell you when Jack came in. Jack didn't work in my band. Mm-hmm. But Jack did come to San Antonio when I'd given up the band with Freddie Coleman's little band at the first keyhole nightclub that I had. Mm-hmm. But there was a fellow yesterday at the concert that they very seldom mentioned around here. I thought was a great trumpet player. He played in my band. Joe Phillips. Yes.
Did you see Joe? I did. And he...

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: That was with Bigfoot, Bill, Phillips, when I was just beginning.

ctx.x: You would never own other riverboats then?

Well, the capital. You owned the capital. Right, but however the boat here was the Sesquahanna. Yeah, I heard. That's on Lake Pontchintrain. That was with Bigfoot, Bill, Phillips, when I was just beginning.
Yeah, you tell me about that and meeting Buddy Petit and all those things.
